comments.overrides: @ampcode/sdk's findAmpCommand() tries its bundled @ampcode/cli BEFORE the AMP_CLI_PATH env var, so a real @ampcode/cli silently outranks the CLI that plugins/amp provisions. The stub declares no bin.amp, so that first resolver returns null and AMP_CLI_PATH wins. It also keeps the ~69MiB @ampcode/cli-<platform> binary out of every install. Bun only honours overrides in the workspace root, so this leaf concern must live here, and it ignores scoped/nested override syntax -- keep the key flat. plugins/amp/test/cli-stub.test.ts fails if the stub stops resolving.
